story.title: My story
story.description: How Raja Shaharyar Ali went from a game-development degree to co-founding TapitCard and driving product and growth for AsaanBill, with a career timeline and 2024 in review.
paragraphs: I studied Computer Game Development at Air University and started selling before I graduated. During COVID I ran Ladenza Clothing, an online thrift store that sold branded clothes through hostel dorms and reached PKR 1 Cr in sales.

In January 2022 I co-founded TapitCard, a digital contact card. I pre-sold the prototype before it was built, then grew it to 3,000+ customers, mostly through B2B sales to corporates. Along the way TapitCard won startup competitions, went through NIC Peshawar's incubator and was picked for K2prenuer.

Since November 2024 I've driven product and growth for AsaanBill at Evamp & Saanga: from the 0→1 launch on 1Bill to Raast approval, 15+ ERP partnerships and $1.8M+ in monthly transaction volume. I've also worked on growth and product for HOMS, Dressup, Gameotivity and SonicEngine AI.
story.closing: I'm working towards becoming the go-to deal closer in any room.
